python_policy: Target: accepted non-root Linux Python 3.12 venv in place; exact package identities checked; no installations
implementation_decisions: Predefined TIMING rows: 3 matched B/C pairs in B-C, C-B, B-C order; Reference only, six rounds each, round one warm-up.
Original preselected smoke membership: 256 training and 128 routine validation sessions per client. Six Reference permutations generated by the unchanged seed rule before any timed run.
Same model, optimiser, learning rate, batch size, update schedule and approved PRG source. No model tuning, test scores or threat labels used.
Server perf_counter_ns spans separate fit workflow, evaluation, secure stages and reporting. Training kernel timers retain finite/gradient guards and are labelled instrumented.
Record-content bytes are counted at the outer ClientApp boundary and cross-checked at the server before identity records are stripped. Server totals are NEVER added to client totals.
Record-content byte accounting follows Flower count_bytes; excludes metadata/framing/TCP/gRPC retries/control traffic and is not network traffic measurement.
Per-run medians across rounds 2-6 precede the 3 paired descriptive summaries. Rounds are not independent repetitions. No performance-based pass threshold or automatic retries.
All protocol and data safety guards retained. No individual C updates/hashes/secret material included in diagnostic exports.
This version does not execute inference microbenchmarks, extra-seed sanity or main experiments. These remain explicit pending gates.
